schema.title: MDA: Mechanics, Dynamics, Aesthetics
schema.description: A game described through the three MDA lenses.

Aesthetic.description: The taxonomy of aesthetics: 1. Sensation (game as sense-pleasure), 2. Fantasy (make-believe), 3. Narrative (drama), 4. Challenge (obstacle course), 5. Fellowship (social framework), 6. Discovery (uncharted territory), 7. Expression (self-discovery), 8. Submission (pastime).

mechanics.description: Mechanics describes the particular components of the game, at the level of data representation and algorithms.

dynamics.description: Dynamics describes the run-time behavior of the mechanics acting on player inputs and each others' outputs over time.

aesthetics.description: Aesthetics describes the desirable emotional responses evoked in the player, when she interacts with the game system.
